[Maya — AI Product Manager]

## Feature Contract ready: needs-you-fees-overdue

**Outcome:** Coach "Needs you" shows overdue fees with one tap to the student's fee record.

---

### 2-minute summary

| | |
|---|---|
| **Problem** | Coaches need a single place to see everything that requires their attention today. "Needs you" already shows children needing feedback; it should also show overdue fees. |
| **Who** | Coaches and tutors using the Coach Today screen. |
| **What we'll build** | A second item in "Needs you": "N fees overdue" with total pending amount (₹ formatted). Tapping opens Fees screen pre-filtered to "Overdue". Both feedback and fees items can appear together. Standard states: loading, error, empty, large data. |
| **What we won't build** | Fee follow-up actions (reminder/check-in/plan), parent-facing reminders, partial/overpaid states, attendance metrics — all later slices. |
| **How to test** | 1. Sign in as coach with an academy that has a student with an overdue invoice. 2. Open Today — verify "X fees overdue" with correct total. 3. Tap it — verify Fees screen opens with "Overdue" filter selected. |

---

### Acceptance criteria

| ID | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-01 | Coach with 2 students with overdue invoices (₹3,500 + ₹2,000), no feedback needed | Opens Today | "2 fees overdue" with "₹5,500 pending", wallet icon (rose), chevron |
| AC-02 | Same + 1 child needing feedback | Opens Today | TWO items in order: feedback (star, grape) then fees (wallet, rose) |
| AC-03 | Overdue fees item showing | Taps it | Fees screen opens with "Overdue" filter selected, scrolled to first overdue |
| AC-04 | No overdue invoices, no feedback needed | Opens Today | "All caught up" and "New requests will show here" |
| AC-05 | Overdue invoice but enrolment ended | Opens Today | "All caught up" (ended enrolments excluded) |
| AC-06 | Overdue invoice for archived student | Opens Today | "All caught up" (archived students excluded) |
| AC-07 | Device offline | Opens Today | "Needs you list could not load. Reference: <ref>" |
| AC-08 | Data loading | Opens Today | "Checking…" muted line in Needs you card |
| AC-09 | 15 students with overdue invoices totalling ₹42,300 | Opens Today | "15 fees overdue" with "₹42,300 pending" — accurate for large data |
| AC-10 | Student has both overdue invoice AND needs feedback | Opens Today | BOTH items appear, each tappable to its own screen |

---

### Out of scope (explicit)
- Fee follow-up actions (reminder, check-in, plan) from the fee detail
- Parent-facing fee reminders
- Partial/overpaid states in the Needs you summary
- Attendance metrics tiles

---

### Product question

**Build this?**
1. **Build as described** (Recommended) — matches prototype, extends existing pattern, no new founder decisions needed
2. Change something — specify what
3. Park it — defer to later

I assumed: overdue = invoice.due_on < today (academy timezone) AND balance_paise > 0 AND student not archived AND enrolment active today; Fees screen already has the filter tabs; loading/error/empty patterns identical to feedback item. Reply "change B" to override.
